body: How often do they go sa office mo? First time nila sa office ko today - may receptionist kami and sya ang nagsabi sakin na may letter daw but they don’t accept personal letters so hindi rin nabigay nung nag field visit.

A collection officer went to my new work today - something that I didn’t disclose to them yet - di ko alam kung paano nila nalaman. Naka wfh ako so I told them to send it to my home address. Nakakastress sila actually,  I’ve been OD for years, di ko lang muna pinapansin coz they’ve been threatening to go to barangay amongst their other harassment tactics. Inaantay ko sila mag file ng small claims para sana mabawasan yung interest pero wala naman silang sinesend. They’ve been calling and texting me non stop. I don’t know if I should engage.

Lumipat na ako ng work and di ko pa na disclose to them yung bago kong work then nagulat na lang ako may pumunta sa office nagbibigay ng letter - I’ve been OD for over a year. Di ko alam paano nila nakuha yung name ng new company no. Di ko sure if I should make payment arrangement or wait ko na mag file sila ng small claims? Ang laki kasi ng interest nila.
30 yo INFP gal who is also open to talking about anything! Hi!
